evidence_slice: The official OS Data Hub OS MasterMap Topography Layer sample endpoint (MMTOPO) is reachable without login but returns only a JavaScript application shell through the available retrieval channel. No Exeter sample feature payload, TOID, polygon coordinates, or feature-bound type/use attributes were readable.

field_evidence.footprint: No record-level polygon coordinates were retrievable from the selected sample endpoint.
field_evidence.type_use: No same-record building type/use attributes were retrievable from the selected sample endpoint.
field_evidence.identity: No record-level Exeter TOID or feature identifier was retrievable from the selected sample endpoint.
